newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - GREY ECONOMY ESTIMATED AT 13.6 PCT OF GDP.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - GREY ECONOMY ESTIMATED AT 13.6 PCT OF GDP.

text.p: The share of Estonia's gross domestic product (GDP) attributable to the grey or shadow economy is 13.6 percent, according to estimates released by the country's statistics department on Wednesday.
The state missed out on 2.1 billion kroons in taxes because of the shadow economy's operation, the office said in a statement.

The lost revenue includes enterprise income taxes worth 200 million kroons, an additional 200 million kroons in private income tax, 400 million kroons in social insurance tax and indirect taxes worth 400 million kroons.
